message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will build a Java project with Maven
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/building-and-testing-java-with-maven

name: Maven Build - Java 17

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up JDK
      uses: actions/setup-java@v1
      with:
        java-version: 17
    - name: Cache Maven packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
    - name: Build with Maven
      run: ./mvnw -P lomboktests -B package --file pom.xml",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Maven multi-module Java project with a pom.xml, and the workflow repeatedly fetches dependencies on every run. Adding a Maven dependency cache (~/.m2/repository) keyed on pom.xml before the build step reuses downloaded dependencies across runs without changing the build command or test coverage. This matches the measured experiment evidence showing a Maven cache step reduced elapsed CI time, and satisfies the cache preconditions (repeated dependency fetching, cache input includes the lockfile-equivalent pom.xml and runner environment).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2"]
}
